dict.string: Foldy needs access to your Desktop folder so you can browse, organize, preview, and bulk-rename files stored there.
Foldy needs access to your Documents folder so you can browse, organize, preview, and bulk-rename files stored there.
Foldy needs access to your Downloads folder so you can browse, organize, preview, and bulk-rename downloaded files.
Foldy needs access to removable drives so you can browse, organize, and bulk-rename files on external storage.
Foldy needs access to network volumes so you can browse, organize, and bulk-rename files on shared drives.
